stdout:
usage: provenant profile [-h] {list,show,use,set,reset,diff} ...

`provenant profile`: list, inspect, switch and compare harness profiles.

positional arguments:
  {list,show,use,set,reset,diff}
    list                knobs and presets
    show                profile files, or the values in force with --resolved
    use                 select a preset
    set                 set knobs: NAME=VALUE ...
    reset               drop knobs (or `preset`) from the profile file
    diff                knobs two presets set differently

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
